name: ClientelingClientBook
tagline: Every associate's client book – preferences, key dates, outreach and wish lists in one app.
description: A complete clienteling module for fashion, luxury and specialty retail: a client book per associate with tiers, sizes and preferences, birthdays and anniversaries, a daily outreach queue that respects marketing consent and contact-gap rules, ready-made message templates, wish lists that notify clients when stock arrives, a key-date calendar, associate books with reassignment, and Power Fx outputs to send the messages from your own app or flow.
features: Outreach queue: follow-ups, birthdays, anniversaries, wish list in stock, thank-you for new clients, win-back for lapsing clients
Consent per channel and minimum days between contacts
Log contact with outcome, next follow-up and purchase
Wish lists with Stock arrived for all waiting clients
Status workflow Prospect → Active → At risk → Lapsed / Do not contact
Role rules: Associate, Store manager, Clienteling admin
Export, undo, keyboard shortcuts, phone layout
